Package jsesh.hierotext Description

OBSOLETE PACKAGE

This package is being developped. It contains an example of a possible memory structure for a JSesh model. Principles are a) to minimize the number of needed classes while being coherent. b) to ease programming. an idea : among leaf element, one finds "breaks". So (using an XML syntax to convey the underlying structure) : 

    
      
      iwi
      
      nwnk
      
      ptpt
      
       n 
	xtU30
the advantage is that one can embed a line in a cadrat without getting something meaningless. Also, it's easier to add stuff to a cadrat, and to delete stuff from it. In placement elements, breaks are ignored ; all signs have the same starting position.
